title: The Real Reason Why Wish Sucks

commenti.body:
Good read! I like your train of thought that Disney as a corporation has become a self hating narcissist- think there’s a lot of room to explore that. Would love to read a follow up that analyses the company going through the stages of narcissistic brainrot. 

Some polite criticism I have is you occasionally resort to strawmen for your arguments. An early example is the use of  “even most diehard of feminists”. Who? Where? When did they say this? By not quoting or using specific citation this comes off as rushed and a bit wishy washy. Like this part of the article could be accelerated to get to the meat of your argument. I highlight this as I think you communicate your ideas and how you go to them well. 

All in all, I’d like to read more from you!
